summary: Twin Disc Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose entry into a new credit agreement refinancing its prior facility. The company, as borrower with Kobelt as guarantor, obtained $30M in term loans from Bank of Montreal and JPMorgan Chase, maturing June 30, 2031, with quarterly installments starting at $375k. A $60M revolving facility was also established. Interest is SOFR-based plus margins of 1.50%-3.00%. No special-situation event occurred; this is a routine debt refinancing.
